sync.title: Your bookmarks are already on their way
sync.subtitle: Everything lands here, automatically
sync.body1: WakeMark is syncing your Twitter/X bookmarks in the background right now. Nothing to configure — just watch the library fill up.
sync.body2Lead: As each bookmark arrives, AI reads it and files it under tags like
sync.noteBody: Sync keeps running on a schedule, so your library stays current without you lifting a finger.

find.title: Find anything in seconds
find.subtitle: Search, filter and sort — your way
find.body1: The search bar matches bookmark text and authors as you type. Stack it with AI tags, the Unread / Read views, or sorting by date and engagement to zero in on any bookmark.
find.noteBody: Search "design", filter by Tech and sort by most liked — that one tweet resurfaces in seconds.

lists.title: Curate lists worth sharing
lists.subtitle: Your best finds, collected
lists.body1: Group bookmarks into themed lists — a design inspiration board, a startup resource shelf, a reading queue for your team.
lists.body2: Flip a list to public and it gets a shareable link anyone can open, no WakeMark account needed.
lists.noteBody: Build a "Best of 2026" list and drop the link in your next post.

digests.title: Your first digest is on us
digests.subtitle: A weekly recap, written by AI
digests.body1: Once your bookmarks start flowing in, we turn the best unread ones into a digest of summaries and themes — in the sidebar and in your inbox.
digests.body2: After the free first issue, a fresh digest arrives every Friday morning. Nothing for you to do.
digests.noteBody: AI summaries, themed sections and highlights, delivered straight to your inbox.

askAi.title: Chat with your bookmarks
askAi.subtitle: A research assistant that knows your library
askAi.body1: See the floating button in the bottom-right corner? It opens Ask AI, your bookmark-aware assistant.
askAi.body2: Ask anything — "What did I save about pricing?", "Summarize this week's AI threads". Answers are synthesized from your own bookmarks, with sources attached.
askAi.noteBody: a private search engine that only reads what you saved.
